title: Witch at the Crossroads
description: A silhouetted witch with long flowing pink hair and a pointed hat stands holding a glowing staff, positioned beside a wooden sign marked with a red X. In the foreground are colorful potted magical plants with blue and yellow bulbous growths, set against a dramatic landscape featuring a giant red eclipsed moon in a starry sky.
prompt: A silhouetted witch wearing a pointed hat stands in a desert landscape at night, long flowing pink ribbons of hair trailing behind her as she holds a glowing staff. In the foreground are several pink pots containing magical glowing plants with blue and golden bulbous forms and swirling green stems. A wooden sign with a red X stands nearby. Behind her is a massive red eclipsed moon dominating the starry sky filled with glowing purple and blue orbs, dramatic fantasy illustration style.
